earnings_release.text: EX-99 2 noc-09302026xearningsrelea.htm EARNINGS RELEASE Document Exhibit 99 News Release Contact: Katie Young (Media) 908-520-9948 katherine.young@ngc.com Randy Sinclair (Investors) 571-835-5513 randy.sinclair@ngc.com Northrop Grumman Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results • Book to bill ratio of 1.5x; Net awards of $16 billion • Backlog increases to $110 billion • Sales increase 7 percent to $11.1 billion • Operating margin rate of 11.4 percent, Segment operating margin rate 1 of 12.1 percent • Diluted earnings per share (EPS) of $7.89 • Company raises 2026 guidance for key financial metrics: ◦ Segment operating income 1 increased by $65 million at the midpoint ◦ MTM-adjusted EPS 1 increased by $0.70 at the midpoint FALLS CHURCH, Va. – October 20, 2026 – Northrop Grumman Corporation (NYSE: NOC) reported third quarter 2026 sales increased 7 percent to $11.1 billion, as compared with $10.4 billion in the third quarter of 2025. Third quarter sales reflect continued strong demand for our global capabilities. Third quarter 2026 net earnings totaled $1.1 billion, or $7.89 per diluted share, as compared with $1.1 billion, or $7.67 per diluted share, in the third quarter of 2025. “In a complex world with the growing need for solutions that scale and perform, our customers continue to turn to Northrop Grumman, and we are delivering with urgency and innovation. Our investments provide the capacity necessary to deliver durable growth as we expand our product offerings and scale our operations,” said Kathy Warden, chair, chief executive officer and president. “I’m confident our new record backlog, well-positioned portfolio and investments, and industry-leading performance will continue to drive sales and earnings growth as reflected in our 2027 outlook.” 1 Non-GAAP measure - see definitions at the end of this earnings release. Northrop Grumman Corporation 2980 Fairview Park Drive • Falls Church, VA 22042-4511 news.northropgrumman.com Northrop Grumman Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results 3 Sales Third quarter 2026 sales increased $699 million, or 7 percent, driven by higher sales at all four sectors, including a 14 percent increase at Aeronautics Systems and a 12 percent increase at Defense Systems. These increases were partially offset by $95 million of higher intercompany eliminations. Operating Income and Margin Rate Third quarter 2026 operating income increased $27 million, or 2 percent, primarily due to $68 million of higher segment operating income 1 , partially offset by a $52 million decrease in the FAS/CAS operating adjustment. Operating margin rate declined to 11.4 percent from 11.9 percent principally due to the decrease in the FAS/CAS operating adjustment. Segment Operating Income and Margin Rate 1 Third quarter 2026 segment operating income 1 increased $68 million, or 5 percent, primarily due to $72 million of higher operating income at Aeronautics Systems. Third quarter 2026 segment operating margin rate 1 of 12.1 percent reflects strong program performance and higher operating margin rates at Aeronautics Systems and Space Systems. Segment operating margin rate 1 decreased from 12.3 percent in the third quarter of 2025 principally due to a prior year $68 million favorable EAC adjustment in the restricted advanced microelectronics portfolio at Mission Systems. Federal and Foreign Income Taxes Third quarter 2026 income tax expense decreased $49 million, or 22 percent, due to a lower effective tax rate (ETR) and $25 million of lower earnings before income taxes. The third quarter 2026 ETR decreased to 13.4 percent from 16.9 percent principally due to higher research credits. Net Earnings Third quarter 2026 net earnings increased $24 million, or 2 percent, primarily due to a $49 million decrease in income tax expense, a $31 million increase in the non-operating FAS pension benefit and a $27 million increase in operating income, partially offset by an $86 million decrease in Other, net largely driven by favorable returns on marketable securities in the prior year. Cash Flows Third quarter 2026 net cash provided by operating activities increased $188 million, or 12 percent, primarily due to improved trade working capital. Third quarter 2026 adjusted free cash flow 1 increased $554 million, or 44 percent, due to proceeds received in connection with the sale of equipment to a customer and higher net cash provided by operating activities. Awards and Backlog Third quarter 2026 net awards totaled $16.4 billion, and backlog totaled $109.6 billion. Significant third quarter new awards include $4.6 billion for restricted programs (primarily at Aeronautics Systems, Space Systems, and Mission Systems), $2.0 billion for Sentinel, $1.4 billion for Virginia Class submarines, $1.3 billion for F-35 at Aeronautics Systems, and $1.0 billion for E-2. 1 Non-GAAP measure - see definitions at the end of this earnings release. reference.summary: Northrop Grumman Corporation operates as an aerospace and defense technology company in the United States, Asia/Pacific, Europe, and internationally. It operates through four segments: Aeronautics Systems, Defense Systems, Mission Systems and Space Systems. The Aeronautics Systems segment designs, develops, produces, integrates, sustains, and modernizes aircraft systems. This segment also offers unmanned autonomous aircraft systems, including high-altitude long-endurance strategic, surveillance and reconnaissance systems; and strategic long-range strike aircraft, tactical fighter and air dominance aircraft, and airborne battle management and command and control systems.
